reason: Expand each denominator factor as a geometric series and each numerator factor by choosing either 1 or -q^(r+s). The resulting terms are indexed by a subset S of I and a multiplicity tuple (m_s), equivalently by a pair (S, lambda) where lambda is a finite multiset of elements of I. The exponent is exactly wt(lambda) + sum_{s in S}(r+s), and the sign is (-1)^{|S|}. Therefore the coefficient of q^j is the signed sum over X_j.
